# Hokkaido Taxi | Kaiya Taxi

> Hokkaido Taxi by Kaiya is a licensed private transfer and taxi company based in Chitose, Hokkaido, Japan. We provide premium airport transfers, private transportation, and sightseeing services across Hokkaido with professional drivers and well-maintained vehicles.

## About
Hokkaido Taxi operates from Chitose, Hokkaido, serving travelers throughout the Hokkaido region. We are a fully licensed transportation company offering safe, comfortable, and reliable rides. Our drivers are professional, courteous, and experienced in navigating Hokkaido's roads in all seasons. We specialize in helping international tourists experience Hokkaido with ease.

## Services
- **Airport Transfer**: Private transfers between New Chitose Airport (CTS) and hotels, resorts, or any Hokkaido destination
- **Hotel Transfer**: Direct transfers between hotels, resorts, and accommodations across Hokkaido
- **Hourly Charter**: Flexible sightseeing with a private driver — explore Hokkaido at your own pace
- **Point-to-Point Transfer**: Door-to-door private transportation to any location in Hokkaido
- **Sightseeing Day Tours**: Curated day trips to Niseko, Furano, Otaru, Lake Toya, Noboribetsu, and more

## Popular Routes
- New Chitose Airport ↔ Sapporo
- New Chitose Airport ↔ Niseko
- New Chitose Airport ↔ Furano
- New Chitose Airport ↔ Otaru
- New Chitose Airport ↔ Rusutsu
- New Chitose Airport ↔ Kiroro
- Sapporo ↔ Niseko
- Sapporo ↔ Otaru
- Any custom route within Hokkaido

## Vehicles
- Compact Sedan (1–4 passengers, 2 luggage)
- Minivan (1–6 passengers, 4 luggage)
- Comfort Van (1–7 passengers, 4 luggage)
- Premium SUV (1–4 passengers, 2 luggage)
- 10-Seater Van (1–9 passengers, 9 luggage)

## Coverage Areas
All of Hokkaido, including: Sapporo, Chitose, New Chitose Airport, Niseko, Furano, Otaru, Rusutsu, Kiroro, Lake Toya, Noboribetsu, Asahikawa, Hakodate, Tomamu, and any other Hokkaido destination.
